theater: 尼羅河三角洲東岸阿瓦里斯

battle.name: 三角洲之戰
battle.theater: 尼羅河三角洲東岸阿瓦里斯
battle.brief: 公元前12世紀末，中王國法老阿姆尼姆哈特三世在位第33年，率軍北上解尼羅河三角洲東岸軍鎮塔羅之圍，同以阿瓦里斯為都的喜克索斯王軍在沼澤與湖汊之間交戰，敵軍潰退溺斃。戰況靠一份數學紙草背面的官方戰記才留傳下來；月牙劍早已退居王權象徵，當場實戰的是斧、矛與複合弓。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場衝突的兩邊都是埃及人，分屬不同的政治秩序。防守一方是阿姆尼姆哈特三世治下的中王國第十二王朝朝廷與三角洲行省軍隊：法老以「上下埃及之王」的名號自居，駐節底比斯，在北方設有三角洲總督與一系列軍鎮，軍隊由地方征召的步兵、王宮警衛與王室馬廄支應的戰車隊組成，步兵大致分為持矛的「尼哈哈」步兵、持斧的斧兵與持複合弓的弓手，另有中王國時期常備的「梅德賈伊」禁衛。進攻一方是進入尼羅河三角洲的喜克索斯王朝，即紙草文所稱「阿瓦里斯的君主」，其權力核心是亞洲裔的戰車武士團與外來兵團，首都阿瓦里斯在泰勒・達巴一帶，二十世紀末以來在該處發掘的宮殿壁畫、數百枚帶王名的封泥與彩繪陶器，把這個對手的行政面貌具體呈現出來。開戰前喜克索斯已控制三角洲東岸大片可耕地，並以圍城的姿態包住埃及在塔羅的軍鎮。曼涅托《埃及史》摘要裏的喜克索斯諸王名單（薩利提斯、鮑科爾、阿波菲斯、希安等）中的「希安」，一般認為即紙草上出現的阿瓦里斯王 Khyan；紙草文正把這些人記作「外邦人」與「阿瓦里斯的諸王」，而不是埃及王室的臣屬。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were both Egyptian, but they belonged to different political orders. The defending side was the court of the Twelfth Dynasty under Amenemhat III together with the military of the Delta provinces: the pharaoh ruled as king of Upper and Lower Egypt from Thebes, the north was administered through a governor of the Delta and a chain of garrison towns, and the army was made up of locally levied infantry, the palace guard and chariot detachments supplied by the royal stables. The infantry fell broadly into spearmen called nekhak, axe-men and archers with composite bows, alongside the Medjay, the standing Nubian guard of the Middle Kingdom. The attacking side was the Hyksos dynasty that had entered the Nile Delta, the 'ruler of Avaris' as the papyrus calls him, whose power rested on an Asiatic chariot aristocracy and foreign troops. Their capital, Avaris, lay at Tell el-Dab'a, where late twentieth-century excavation recovered palace wall paintings, several hundred inscribed sealings and painted pottery, making the administration of this opponent concrete. Before the fighting began, the Hyksos already held much of the fertile eastern Delta and had invested the Egyptian town of Tjaru. The list of Hyksos kings in the epitome of Manetho (Salitis, Bnon, Apophis, Chian and the rest) contains a 'Chian' who is generally identified with the Avaris king Khyan named on the papyrus; the papyrus records these people as 'foreigners' and as 'the kings of Avaris' rather than as subjects of the Egyptian court.
people: 留下記錄的只有一位國王、一位對手，加上後來抄錄與整理他們的人。法老是阿姆尼姆哈特三世，第十二王朝中王國的第五位君主，王座名「賽赫特普伊布拉」；紙草的戰記寫在他在位第33年，說明他曾親自率軍北上解塔羅之圍，並最終平安返回南方都城底比斯。對手是喜克索斯王 Khyan，學界通常讀作「希安」或「基揚」，正是曼涅托名單裏的 Chian；他的王名圈印見於大英博物館所藏的「喜克索斯・萊因德紙草」，該文件與數學紙草出自同一套抄本系統，兩份合起來才把圍城、解圍與追擊的過程拼出來。真正把這些字句抄到莎草紙上的書吏是艾赫莫斯（阿姆托特之子），約在公元前1700至1600年間完成數學正文的重抄；戰記部分則出自另一位書吏之手，兩者筆跡不同，說明戰記是後來謄錄的官方檔案。埃及方面的將領姓名沒有完整留下，紙草只以職銜記載「軍隊的將領」；可作對照的是同代中王國的名將奈赫特，他曾奉命遠征努比亞並帶回戰俘與財貨，以及阿姆尼姆哈特三世的兩位維齊爾索貝克姆哈特與阿梅尼。
peopleEn: Only one king, one opponent, and the later scribes who copied and arranged them are on record. The pharaoh was Amenemhat III, the fifth ruler of the Twelfth Dynasty in the Middle Kingdom, whose throne name was Sehetepibre. The campaign journal is dated to year 33 of his reign and says that he personally led the army north to relieve the siege of Tjaru and eventually returned in safety to the southern capital of Thebes. His opponent was the Hyksos king Khyan, read as 'Chian' or 'Kian', the same figure as Manetho's Chian; his cartouche survives on the Hyksos Rhind Papyrus in the British Museum, a document that belongs to the same scribal complex as the mathematical papyrus, and it is the two together that allow the siege, the relief and the pursuit to be reconstructed. The scribe who actually copied these words onto papyrus was Ahmose, son of Abtot, who produced the recension of the mathematical recto around 1700 to 1600 BC; the campaign journal is written by a different hand, so the journal itself is a later official copy of the record. No Egyptian general is named in full: the papyrus gives only the office, 'commander of the army'. For comparison one may set beside it Nacht, the Middle Kingdom commander who led an expedition into Nubia and brought back captives and booty, and the two viziers of Amenemhat III, Sobekemhat and Ameny.
kits: 卡牌上的月牙劍，在這場戰役裏的位置需要說清楚：到了公元前12世紀末，埃及月牙劍早已不是線列步兵的制式兵器。舊王朝與古王國時代那種鉤狀單刃、砍下去不用拔的短刀，經過第一中間期的式微，在中王國的墓葬壁畫上退到王權象徵的位置：它是法老近侍的佩劍、王室儀仗的寶物，也是塞赫邁特、阿蒙等神祇的標誌性持物，與王尾合成象形符號「王」字，說明這柄刀在體系裏代表的是王權本身。真正決定這場三角洲之戰勝負的，是雙方陣中的實戰裝備：埃及步兵用短柄斧（塞赫姆式與阿克塞什式）、長矛與複合弓（凱謝特弓），配以小盾；埃及的戰車是雙輪輕型，車上射手持弓、身前立有皮盾，王室馬廄的馬匹是整個體系最貴的部件。喜克索斯一方同樣以複合弓為主力，配長柄斧、矛與自己的戰車，箭鏃形制也更發達。除武器外，攻城與野戰器材同樣關鍵：塔羅是土坯牆加壕溝的軍鎮，糧食靠尼羅河東支的駁船運入，軍隊沿途以繩索與槓木架渡運河；柴薪、皮革、繩索、椰棗與大麥是全軍的日常消耗，銅料則由紅海商路與三角洲口岸輸入。
kitsEn: The card's weapon, the khopesh, has to be placed carefully in this campaign: by the end of the twelfth century BC the sickle-shaped single-edged sword had long ceased to be the standard arm of the line infantry. The khopesh of the Old and Middle Kingdoms, a hooked blade that did not need to be pulled back out of a body, faded during the First Intermediate Period and, in Middle Kingdom tomb painting, retreated to the position of a symbol of kingship: it was the weapon carried by the king's own attendants, a treasure of the royal ceremonial, and the attribute of gods such as Sekhmet and Amun, combined with the royal tail to form the hieroglyph for 'king', which is to say that the blade stood for kingship itself. What actually decided this battle in the Delta was the practical kit of the formations on both sides. Egyptian infantry carried short-handled axes of the sekhem and aksesh types, spears and composite bows of the kheset type, with small shields; Egyptian chariots were light two-wheeled vehicles carrying an archer with a bow and a leather shield across the front, and the horses of the royal stables were the most expensive component of the system. The Hyksos likewise made the composite bow their main weapon, with long-handled axes, spears and their own chariots, and a more developed repertoire of arrowheads. Beside the weapons, siege and field equipment mattered just as much: Tjaru was a mudbrick town with a ditch, food was carried in by barges on the eastern branches of the Nile, and the army improvised its crossings of the canals with rope and wooden poles. Firewood, leather, rope, dates and barley were the daily consumables of the whole force, while copper reached Egypt through the Red Sea trade routes and the Delta ports.
tactics: 紙草文留下的不是戰術教材，而是骨架：包圍、解圍、交手、潰散、追擊溺斃。因此戰術只能靠三角洲的地形同當時的兵制去重建。喜克索斯圍住塔羅靠的是封鎖：東面是鹽沼與運河，北面是寬闊的湖汊，陸上只剩有限通道，圍城方可以近乎不設工事地監視全城。埃及解圍的關鍵是水陸並進——大軍沿尼羅河東支河道北進，戰車縱隊在能承重的堤道與沙脊上展開，弓手在兩翼，矛兵與斧兵在中央與側翼護住車隊，接近敵陣前以弓矢先行覆蓋，再由戰車衝擊引開對手，最後步兵壓上。喜克索斯方面的反應是潰退往北：三角洲的沼澤與湖泊本是撤退方向，也變成陷阱，敗兵在淺水與運河之間分散，許多人溺斃，紙草文只以「許多敵人溺斃在湖中」一語帶過。補給端，埃及靠三角洲行省與上埃及的穀倉供應，靠船運麥、麵包與啤酒，靠馬匹拉車走堤道；喜克索斯則以就地徵收同阿瓦里斯的儲備維持。
tacticsEn: What the papyrus preserves is not a tactical manual but a skeleton: investment, relief, contact, rout, pursuit and drowning. The tactics must therefore be reconstructed from the terrain of the Delta and from the military system of the time. The Hyksos held Tjaru by blockade: salt marsh and canals to the east, wide lake branches to the north, and on land only a few usable approaches, so that the besiegers could watch the whole town without extensive works. The relief of the siege depended on moving by water and land together. The host advanced north along the eastern branch of the Nile, chariot columns deployed on the raised dykes and sand ridges that would carry them, archers on the wings, spear and axe infantry on the centre and flanks to shield the chariots; before contact the bows were worked to soften the enemy, the chariots charged to draw them, and the infantry followed up. The Hyksos answer was a flight to the north: the marshes and lakes of the Delta were meant to be their escape route and became a trap, the beaten scattered among shallow water and canals, many drowned, and the papyrus sums it up in a single phrase, that many of the enemy drowned in the lake. On the supply side, Egypt drew grain from the Delta provinces and from the granaries of Upper Egypt, moved wheat, bread and beer by boat, and hauled carts and fodder along the dykes, while the Hyksos maintained themselves from local levy and from the stores of Avaris.
data: 可查的數字都在文獻裏，不在戰場上。紙草的戰記屬於在位第33年；阿姆尼姆哈特三世通常被定在公元前1860至1814年，第33年約當公元前1827年，這與喜克索斯常被定在公元前1650年入埃及的年代對不上，所以學界有兩種解讀：或把「賽赫特普伊布拉」當作中王國的君主，或認為這個王座名被後來沿用的十三王朝君主重新使用，萊因德紙草正是同一名號跨王朝重現的例子。喜克索斯王 Khyan 依比塔克等人的修訂年表約在公元前1610至1590年在位；百科類文獻把「三角洲之戰」放在公元前1195年或公元前1186年，本卡採用的公元前1175年即出於戰爭一覽表的傳統編年。月份依埃及民用曆推算：該曆以「索提斯月」一日為年首，約在8月29日，洪水季（阿赫特）第一月約在6月25日至7月24日之間，戰記把戰事放在洪水季之初，故本條目取七月。地理數字：泰勒・達巴在北緯30.79度、東經31.82度，阿瓦里斯與其後的拉美西斯城比鄰，北面是今日曼扎拉湖一帶的沼澤。兵力、損耗與繳獲數字，紙草文一個都沒有留下——這場戰爭最大的數據，就是它的空白。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are all in the documents; none are from the battlefield. The campaign journal belongs to year 33 of a reign. Amenemhat III is usually dated to about 1860 to 1814 BC, which puts his year 33 near 1827 BC, and that does not sit with the Hyksos, conventionally placed in Egypt from about 1650 BC, so scholars offer two readings: either the 'Sehetepibre' of the papyrus is the Middle Kingdom king, or the throne name was taken up again by a later Thirteenth Dynasty king, the reuse of the name Sehetepibre being itself attested in the record of the late Twelfth and Thirteenth Dynasties. Khyan's reign runs from about 1610 to 1590 BC in the revised chronology of Bietak and colleagues, while general reference works place the 'Battle of the Delta' at 1195 BC or 1186 BC; the year 1175 BC used here follows the traditional chronology of the war list. The month follows the Egyptian civil calendar: the year began on the first of Thoth, about 29 August, and the first month of the inundation season, Akhet, fell roughly between 25 June and 24 July; the journal places the operations at the start of the flood season, so this entry takes July. Geographically, Tell el-Dab'a lies at 30.79 degrees north and 31.82 degrees east, Avaris adjoins the later city of Pi-Ramesses, and to the north lie the marshes around what is today Lake Manzala. Numbers of men, losses and booty: the papyrus preserves not one of them. That blankness is itself the central datum of this campaign.
cause: 開戰的理由，紙草文自己給了線索：法老在位第33年動身北征，去解喜克索斯對塔羅的圍。這背後是第二中間期的結構性矛盾。喜克索斯自黎凡特進入尼羅河河谷後，控制了三角洲東岸最肥沃的耕地、尼羅河下游的運輸樞紐與通往敘利亞的商路，並以阿瓦里斯為中心建起自己的王庭；對底比斯的中央王權而言，這等於是把「埃及的糧倉」從稅冊上劃走，也等於是在國境之內長期容忍一個不受節制的政權。喜克索斯諸王在王名錄上仍被列作埃及的諸王，卻以自己的王名圈、自成體系的宮廷與軍隊統治三角洲，這種「臣屬而不同君」的狀態，是中王國末期與十三王朝無法長期維持的平衡。另外兩項具體因素推高了衝突強度：一是埃及北部有眾多陳舊的軍鎮與關卡，防守方只要守住塔羅，就等於把整條東岸走廊的門戶捏在手上；二是季節——三角洲的糧食、船舶與戰車通行都受洪水季水位支配，汛期既決定船能否北上，也決定沼澤能不能通行，於是可以動手的月份不多，而開戰的時機往往正好卡在這些窗口上。
causeEn: The papyrus supplies the reason for the war itself: in year 33 of his reign the pharaoh set out north to lift the Hyksos siege of Tjaru. Behind that lay the structural contradiction of the Second Intermediate Period. After the Hyksos entered the Nile valley from the Levant they held the best farmland of the eastern Delta, the transport hub of the lower river and the trade road to Syria, and built their own court around Avaris; for the central kingship at Thebes this was the loss of 'the granary of Egypt' from the tax registers, and the long-term tolerance of an uncontrolled power inside the frontier. In the king lists the Hyksos rulers were still counted among the kings of Egypt, yet they ruled the Delta with their own cartouches, their own court and their own army; that condition of 'subjects who are not subjects' could not be held in balance by the late Middle Kingdom and the Thirteenth Dynasty. Two concrete factors raised the intensity of the confrontation. First, the north was guarded by a chain of old garrison towns and checkpoints, so as long as the defender held Tjaru it held the door of the whole eastern corridor. Second, there was the season: grain, shipping and chariot movement in the Delta all obey the flood level, the inundation decided whether boats could run north and whether the marshes could be crossed, so the months in which an army could act were few, and the moment chosen for opening a campaign often fell exactly into one of those narrow windows.
impact: 這場戰役的直接影響有限，深遠影響卻不小。直接方面：塔羅之圍被解，喜克索斯退回阿瓦里斯或其外圍據點，埃及在三角洲東岸的處境暫時穩住；但喜克索斯王朝並未被削弱也未被推翻，阿瓦里斯仍在對方手上，埃及王朝對北方的實際控制依然停在尼羅河三角洲的南部。真正改變後世認識的，是這份文獻本身的地位：它是目前所知唯一一份當代的埃及人對喜克索斯交戰的記錄，學者重建第二中間期的政治與軍事，主要就靠紙草背面的戰記加上「喜克索斯・萊因德紙草」的互證。紙草的正反兩面也示範了埃及的檔案制度：正面是純粹的算術，背面是編年與軍事的混合抄本；一份正本同時承載算術與年記的做法，是後來王室年表與神廟日誌一類官方文件的先驅。軍備層面上，這次對抗也讓埃及加速吸收喜克索斯的戰車操典、複合弓技術與裝甲思路，等到第十八王朝建軍時，埃及的戰車兵已能同喜克索斯的繼承者周旋，最終在十八王朝初期把喜克索斯逐出河谷，閉合了這場戰爭沒有閉合的那條線。考古上，泰勒・達巴出土的宮殿遺址與數百枚帶王名的封泥，讓「阿瓦里斯的君主」從紙草上的稱號變成可考的行政實體。
impactEn: The direct effect of this battle was limited; its long-term effect was not. Directly: the siege of Tjaru was lifted, the Hyksos withdrew towards Avaris and its satellite posts, and Egypt's position in the eastern Delta steadied for a time; but the Hyksos dynasty was neither weakened nor overthrown, Avaris stayed in their hands, and the effective reach of the Egyptian crown over the north still stopped at the southern edge of the Delta. What truly changed later understanding was the standing of the document itself: it is the only known contemporary Egyptian record of a campaign fought against the Hyksos, and the political and military reconstruction of the Second Intermediate Period rests mainly on the journal on the back of the papyrus read against the Hyksos Rhind Papyrus. The two sides of the scroll also demonstrate Egyptian archival practice: the recto is pure arithmetic, the verso a copybook of chronology and military narrative, and a single exemplar carrying both arithmetic and annalistic record is the ancestor of the royal annals and the temple journals of the later New Kingdom. In the military sphere the confrontation accelerated Egypt's adoption of Hyksos chariot drills, composite bow technique and ideas about armour, so that by the founding of the Eighteenth Dynasty the Egyptian chariot arm could stand against the successors of the Hyksos, and in the early Eighteenth Dynasty finally expelled them from the valley, closing the line this battle left open. Archaeologically, the palace at Tell el-Dab'a and its hundreds of inscribed sealings turned 'the ruler of Avaris' from a phrase on a papyrus into an administrative reality.
result: 按紙草文的敘述，結果是埃及方面的解圍成功：塔羅的圍解了，喜克索斯的軍隊在交手中被擊潰，敗兵向北逃入沼澤與湖汊，許多人溺斃在水裏；法老記錄自己平安返回底比斯，戰記的時間線就在此收束。但勝負的範圍要說清楚：這不是驅逐戰。喜克索斯王朝繼續踞有阿瓦里斯，繼續控制三角洲東岸，Khyan 仍然是那片土地的主人，埃及王權仍然只能隔著沼澤與運河同他們作戰。從軍事上看，埃及贏在把追擊引進了自己最熟悉的水網，把對手的退路變成了死地；從政治上看，這場戰役只是把一場無法用一次會戰解決的僵持又延長了一段，尼羅河三角洲的主權之爭，還要再打三百年。史料上同樣值得記一筆：這場戰爭沒有留下戰報、沒有留下人數，只有一份官方記事體的殘卷，以及它的抄本史。
resultEn: By the account of the papyrus the result was a successful relief: the siege of Tjaru was broken, the Hyksos army was routed in contact, the beaten fled north into marsh and lake, many of them drowned in the water, and the king recorded his safe return to Thebes, at which point the journal's timeline closes. The scope of that result has to be stated: this was not a war of expulsion. The Hyksos dynasty continued to hold Avaris and the eastern Delta, continued to control the country, and Khyan remained master of that territory, while the Egyptian crown still faced him across marsh and canal. Militarily, Egypt won by drawing the pursuit into the water system it knew best, turning the enemy's line of retreat into a dead end. Politically, the battle merely prolonged a stalemate that no single engagement could resolve: the struggle over the sovereignty of the Nile Delta had another three hundred years to run. The record is worth noting in itself: this campaign left no despatch, no headcount and no booty list, only an official narrative preserved in fragmentary copy, together with the history of its copying.
